leads.claim: When a lint-style checker exempts a literal (an alpha stop, a marker), strip the exempt literal from the line and still test the rest, because a per-line exemption lets any violation that shares the line pass with it.
leads.because: hirelane's check-law exempted whole lines naming box-shadow/mask-image or holding one white plane; seeded `box-shadow: ... #e11d48` passed until the literals were stripped instead (ea206f1).
